title: Balochistan Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Act 2019

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Act 2019
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT X OF 2019
ACT X OF 2019
BALOCHISTAN BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE
AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ACT, 2019
An Act to provide for re-constituting and
establishing of the
Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education in
Balochistan
and the matters ancillary thereto or connected
therewith
[Gazette of Balochistan Extraordinary,
25th October, 2019]
No.
PAB/Legis; V (07)/2019, dated 25.10.2019.---The Balochistan Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Bill
No. 07 of 2019 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on
12th October, 2019 and assented to by the Governor Balochistan, on 24th
October, 2019 is hereby published as an Act of the Balochitsan Provincial
Assembly.
Preamble.---WHEREAS, it is expedient to re-constitute,
recognize and establish Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education in
Balochistan and to provide for the matters ancillary thereto or connected
therewith:
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title, extent and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called "The Balochistan Boards of Intermediate and
Secondary Education Act, 2019".
(2) It
shall extends to the whole of Balochistan.
(3) It
shall come into force at once.

Preamble.---WHEREAS, it is expedient to re-constitute,

Balochistan and to provide for the matters ancillary thereto or connected
therewith:
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Definitions.---In this Act, unless there is anything repugnant
in the subject or context: -
(a) "Act"
means The Balochistan Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Act, 2019;
(b) "Board"
means a Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education constituted or
reconstituted under the Act;
(c) "Calendar"
means the calendar of events, activities schedule of exams etc. prepared and
approved by a Board;
(d) "Chairman"
means the Chairman of a Board;
(e) "College"
means an institution, public or private, within the jurisdiction of a Board and
recognized by it for intermediate education, and includes a college having
intermediate and degree classes and affiliated to the University for the degree
classes;
(f) "Committee"
means a committee constituted under this Act;
(g) "Controller
of Examinations" means the Controller of Examinations of the Board;
(h) "Controlling
Authority" means the Controlling Authority as specified in section 12;
(i) "Government"
means the Government of Balochistan;
(j) "Head
of an Institution" means the Principal of a college or
Principal/Headmaster or Headmistress of a school;
(k) "Institution"
means a college or a school;
(l) "Intermediate
College" means an institution recognized for imparting instruction to
Class XI and Class XII and includes an institution having classes for
intermediate and secondary education;
(m) "Intermediate
Education" means education pertaining to Class XI and Class XII or Higher
Secondary Education;
(n) "Member"
means a member of a Board;
(o) "Prescribed"
means prescribed by regulations or rules;
(p) "Principal"
means the Head of a college or a school;
(q) "Recognized"
means recognized by a Board;
(r) "Regulations"
means regulations made or deemed to have been made under this Act;
(s) "Rules"
means the rules made or deemed to have been made under this Act;
(t) "Schedule"
means schedules attached to this Act;
(u) "School"
means an institution public or private, within the jurisdiction of a Board and
recognized by it;
(v) "Secondary
Education" means education pertaining to Class IX and Class X and such
other classes as may be declared by the Government to be classes secondary
education;
(w) "Secretary"
means the Secretary of a Board functioning under the provisions and powers
prescribed under this Act or the rules made thereunder; and
(x) "University"
means the University having jurisdiction within an area in which a Board
functions under section 5.

Constitution and reconstitution of the Boards

No.
PAB/Legis; V (07)/2019, dated 25.10.2019.---The Balochistan Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Bill
No. 07 of 2019 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on
12th October, 2019 and assented to by the Governor Balochistan, on 24th
October, 2019 is hereby published as an Act of the Balochitsan Provincial
Assembly.
Preamble.---WHEREAS, it is expedient to re-constitute,
recognize and establish Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education in
Balochistan and to provide for the matters ancillary thereto or connected
therewith:
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
3. Constitution
and reconstitution of the Boards.---(1)
The Government may, by a notification in the official Gazette, establish one or
more Boards or reconstitute a Board already established, in respect of such
areas or such institutions as it may deem necessary:
Provided
that, the Board constituted under the Balochistan Board of Intermediate and
Secondary Education Ordinance, 1977 (Ordinance No. X of 1977) i.e. Board of
Intermediate and Secondary Education Quetta, shall be reconstituted as
"Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education Quetta" soon after the
commencement of this Act, under the provisions of the Act.
(2) Upon
constitution of a board under subsection (1), the Government may reconstitute
the Board(s) already constituted under this Act, with such areas of
jurisdiction and such institutions as it may deem necessary.

recognize and establish Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education in
Balochistan and to provide for the matters ancillary thereto or connected
therewith:
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
5. Jurisdiction
of the Boards.---(1) A Board shall
exercise the powers in respect of and within such areas or such institutions
and within such area as may be determined and notified by the Government from
time to time:
Provided
that, all the institutions within the Province of Balochistan over with the
Balochistan Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Quetta was
exercising its powers under the Balochistan Board of Intermediate and Secondary
Education Ordinance, 1977 (Ordinance No. X of 1977), immediately before the
commencement of this Act, shall fall within the jurisdiction of the Boards
constituted for reconstituted under section 3, in their respective areas, till
such time as may deem fit by the Controlling Authority.
(2) The
Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, authorize the Board of
Intermediate and Secondary Education Quetta reconstituted in consequence of
constitution of new Boards, to continue, to exercise the powers of the Board
under the Act as it is exercising before the constitution of new Boards for a
period of two years from the date of constitution of new Boards in respect of
such matters and institutions as may be specified in the said notification.

Balochistan and to provide for the matters ancillary thereto or connected
therewith:
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
6. Constitution
of a Board.---(1) The Board shall
consist of the following members, namely:-
(a) the
Chairman;
(b) the
Vice Chancellor of the University, or his nominee not less than the rank of
Professor or Grade 20 officer;
(c) the
Chairman/Chairmen of other Board/Boards constituted in the province under the
provisions of the Act;
(d) the
Director of Colleges and Higher Education, Balochistan;
(e) the
Director Technical Education Balochistan;
(f) the
Director of Education (Schools) Balochistan;
(g) one
representative of syndicate of the University nominated by the Vice Chancellor;
(h) Additional
Secretary (Dev.) Government of Balochistan Education Department concerned or
any nominee by the department concerned not below the rank of Deputy Secretary;
(i) two
Principals of Degree Colleges (one from Boys and the other from Girls colleges)
situated within the jurisdiction of the Board to be nominated by the
Controlling Authority;
(j) two
representatives from Principals/Senior Headmasters /Headmistress of the schools
(one from male and one from female school) situated within the jurisdiction of
the Board to be nominated by the Controlling Authority;
(k) one
Principal of a renowned private college and one Principal of renown private
school to be nominated by the Controlling Authority on the recommendation of
the Chairman Board;
(l) one
representative of Finance Department not below the rank of Deputy Secretary;
and
(m) one
permanent employee of the Board, not below the rank of Grade-18, nominated by
the Chairman of the Board.
(2) The
names of the nominated members shall be notified in the official Gazette.
(3) The
term of office of members, other than ex-officio members, shall be three years.
(4) No
member appointed by virtue of his office shall continue to be a member if he
ceases to hold that office.
(5) When
a person ceases to be a member of a Board, he shall cease to be a member of any
committee of which he may be a member.

It

8. Removal
of a member.---(1) A member shall
be liable to be removed by the Controlling Authority, if he,-
(a) becomes
of unsound mind; or
(b) is
declared insolvent by a competent Court of law; or
(c) is
convicted of an offence by a Court of law involving moral turpitude; or
(d) is
found negligent in discharge of his/her functions.
(2) The
decision of the Controlling Authority removing a member from his office under
subsection (1) shall be final and shall not be questioned by or before any
court of other authority:
Provided
that, no decision under subsection (1) shall be made unless the member to be
affected thereby is offered an opportunity of personal hearing by the authority
notified by the Government.

9. Casual
vacancies.---(1) Whenever there
occurs a vacancy in the membership of the Board due to death, resignation or
removal, it shall be filled in accordance with the provisions of this Act.
(2) The
person who fills the vacancy referred to in subsection (1) shall be a member of
the Board for the remaining period of the three-year's term of the office.

10. Meetings
of the Board.---(1) A Board shall hold
its meeting ordinarily twice in a year for which the notices shall be issued
seven days prior to the date of the meeting.
(2) The
Chairman may, whenever he considers necessary, and shall, or on a requisition
from at least seven members, call a meeting of the Board.
(3) The
quorum for meetings of a Board shall be more than half of the membership of the
Board.

11. Powers
of the Board.---(1) Subject to the
provisions of this Act, the Board shall have powers to organize, regulate,
develop and control Intermediate Education and Secondary Education.
(2) In
particular and without prejudice to the generality of the powers conferred by
the preceding subsection, the Board shall have the following powers:-
(a) to
hold and conduct all examinations pertaining to Intermediate Education,
Secondary Education, Technical Education, Pakistani and Classical language and
such other examinations as may be determined by the Government;
(b) to
prescribe courses of study for its examinations;
(c) to
lay down conditions for recognition of institutions;
(d) to
accord, refuse or withdraw recognition, wholly or partly. To accord
recognition, to the school and college examination to such schools or colleges
as are within the jurisdiction of the Board, if it is satisfied, on the basis
of the inspection report received in the case of school maintained by the
Government of Pakistan from the Officer on Special Duty, Ministry of Education
Government of Pakistan, or any other authority appointed for the purpose by the
said Ministry, and in the case of other schools/colleges, from the Director of
Schools, Education Department concerned/Director of Colleges, Education
Department concerned or any other authorized authority that the condition
prescribed for recognition have been satisfactorily fulfilled;
(i) in
the case of other schools (not governed by the Government), after considering
inspection reports from the Inspection Committee appointed by the Board for the
purpose; and
(ii) in
the case of Intermediate Colleges (Private) after considering reports from an
Inspection Committee appointed by the Board in this behalf;
If
the Board on the basis of a report received from any of the above quarters is
satisfied that the conditions of recognition have ceased to be fulfilled by any
school/college recognized by it, the Board may, after giving the management of
the school/college an opportunity of being heard, suspend/cancel the
affiliation;
(e) to
inspect and arrange for inspection of recognized institutions and call for
inspection reports in respect of such institutions, other than the institutions
run by the Government of Pakistan;
(f) to
lay down conditions for admission to its examination, to determine the
eligibility of candidates and to admit them to such examinations;
(g) to
grant certificates and diplomas to persons who have passed their examinations
and to withdraw such certificates and diplomas;
(h) to
fix, demand and receive such fees as may be prescribed;
(i) to

It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
13. Powers
of the Controlling Authority.---(1)
The Controlling Authority shall have the power to inspect and cause an
inspection to be made, by such person or persons as it may direct, of the
Offices, activities and funds of and the conduct of examinations by a Board,
and to cause an enquiry to be made in any manner in respect of any matter
concerning a Board, or the discharge of functions by the members, officers and
employees of the Board.
(2) The
Controlling Authority may at any time suspend a member, an officer or an
employee of the Board on reasonable grounds given in writing.
(3) The
Controlling Authority may communicate to a Board the result of such inspection
or inquiry and may advise a Board to take such action and within such period as
may be specified.
(4) The
Board shall report to the Controlling Authority the action taken on such
communication.
(5) Where
a Board does not within a specified time, take action to the satisfaction of
the Controlling Authority, the Controlling Authority may, after considering any
explanation made by a Board, issue such directions as it deems fit, and the
Chairman shall comply with such directions.
(6) If
the Controlling Authority is satisfied that any proceeding of a Board or a
committee is not in conformity with the provisions of this Act or Regulations
or Rules framed there under or in public interest, the Controlling Authority
may, without prejudice to the foregoing provisions of this section, by order in
writing, annul such proceedings:
Provided
that before making any such order, the Controlling Authority shall, through the
Chairman, call upon the Board or the committee, as the case may by, to show
cause that why such an order should not be made.
(7) The
Controlling Authority may, from time to time, direct a Board to conduct its
affairs and to perform its functions in such a manner as may be specified.
(8) The
Controlling Authority may require a board to furnish:-
(a) any
return, statement, estimate, statistics or other information regarding any
matter under the control of the Board, or
(b) a
report of any such matter; or
(c) a
copy of any document in the charge of the Board; and the Chairman shall comply
with every such requisition.
(9) Notwithstanding
anything to the contrary contained in this Act, the Controlling Authority may-
(a) place
the services of any of the officers or other employees of any Board at the
disposal of the Government or any other Board, on deputation, for such period
and on such terms and conditions as determined in the deputation policy of the
Government or any other policy in vogue:
Provided
that such terms and conditions shall not be less favorable than those
admissible to him immediately before his transfer;
(b) make
appointments on deputation in a Board against the posts of Chairman, Secretary
and Controller from the Education Department or any other concerned department

16. Chairman.---(1) The Chairman shall be the principal
executive and academic officer of the Board and shall, when present, preside at
the meetings of:
(a) the
Board; and
(b) the
Committees of the Board.
(2) The
Chairman shall be a whole time officer and shall be appointed by the
Controlling Authority on such terms and conditions as prescribed by the
Government.
(3) The
Chairman shall hold office for a period of three years from the date of his
appointment and may be re-appointed for another such term:
Provided
that the Controlling Authority may at any time, review the work of the Chairman
and if on such review it is satisfied that in the interest of the Board, or for
any other sufficient cause, it is necessary to do so, it may, after giving the
Chairman an opportunity of showing cause against the proposed action, reduce
the term of office of the Chairman to such period as it may determine.
(4) It
shall be the duty of the Chairman to ensure that the provisions of this Act;
and the regulations, rules and directions of the Controlling Authority are observed
and carried out, and he shall exercise all powers necessary for this purpose.
(5) If
at any time the office of the Chairman is vacant, temporarily or otherwise, by
reason of leave, illness or other cause for a period not exceeding one year,
the Controlling Authority shall make such arrangements for carrying on the
duties of the office of the Chairman as it may deem fit.
(6) The
Chairmen may, in case of urgency, create a temporary post in the Board and may
appoint against the post for a period not exceeding six months.
(7) In
any emergency arising out of the administrative business of the Board and
requiring, in the opinion of the Chairman, immediate action, the Chairman may
take action as he may feel necessary and shall report the action taken to the
Board at its next meeting for approval.
(8) The
Chairman shall exercise such other powers as may be prescribed by regulations.

recognize and establish Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education in
Balochistan and to provide for the matters ancillary thereto or connected
therewith:
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
22. Power
of a Board to make regulations.---(1)
A Board may, subject to the approval of the Government, frame regulations, not
inconsistent with the provisions of this Act, to carry out the purposes of this
Act:
Provided that-
(a) a
Board shall not propose draft of regulations effecting the constitution or
power of any authority of the Board until such authority has been given an
opportunity of expressing an opinion in writing upon the proposals;
(b) the
draft of regulations shall be forwarded to the Controlling Authority and shall
not be effective until it has been approved by the Controlling Authority; and
(c) a
Board shall not have the power to make any regulation or adopt any rules or
regulations concerning efficiency and discipline of the officers/officials and
other employees which is not in conformity with the rules made by the
Government.
(2) In
particular and without prejudice to the generality of the foregoing powers,
such regulations may provide for,-
(a) the
terms and conditions of service of the employees of a Board, including matters
relating to appointment, pay, allowances, leave, promotion, retirement, etc. of
such employees;
Explanation.---The
terms and conditions of the services should be in conformity with rules
applicable to Government servants carrying equivalent pay scales and other
benefits.
(b) the
constitution of Pension or Provident Fund or both for the benefit of the
officers and other employees of the Board;
(c) The
admission of institutions to the privilege of recognition and withdrawal of
recognition;
(d) A
general scheme of studies, including the total number of subjects to be taught
and the duration of courses; and
(e) All
other matters required under any of the provisions of this Act to be provided
by regulations.

together with the report of the auditor.

28. Members
of the Board prohibited from deriving monetary gains.---(1) No member shall draw any fee or other
remuneration in any capacity whatever from the funds of the Board or enter into
any contract with the Board directly or through any other person in connection
with the affairs of the Board:
Provided

in accordance with the terms and conditions of his appointment.
(2) Nothing
in this section shall be deemed to prohibit a member of a committee to receive
from the Board, remuneration in lump sum for writing, compiling or editing a
book intended to be prescribed for an examination of the Board.

supplies any such book, shall be eligible to become a member of such Board, or
a committee thereof or continue as such after having acquired any such
interest.

38. Repeal
and Savings.---(1) The Balochistan
Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1977 (Ordinance No. X
of 1977) is hereby repealed.
(2) Notwithstanding
anything to the contrary contained in this Act, everything done, action taken,
jurisdiction or power conferred, recognition granted and any appointment,
rules, regulations made or notification, order or notice issued legal or saved
administrative proceedings or action taken under any of the provisions of the

continued and, so far as may be, deemed to have respectively been done, taken,
conferred, granted, made and issued under this Act and the Regulations and
